newsitem.title: UK: Barclays, HSBC lead banks higher.
newsitem.headline: Barclays, HSBC lead banks higher.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Bank Plc and HSBC Holdings led the British banking sector higher on Wednesday as buyers emerged after recent sector weakness and press reports speculated that an end to the mortgage price war is near.

Barclays advanced 8p to 959p by 1029 GMT after falling over eight percent in the last three weeks. HSBC Holdings gained 9p to 1294-1/2p. A short squeeze in the market contributed to today's gains in Barclays, traders said.
Banks had been weak this week but news yesterday the Nationwide Building Society raised its mortgage rate prompted press reports that an end to the mortgage price war is nearer.
Analysts believe that competition in mortgage prices will be more stable in the near term.
"The end of mortgage price war is not something that just happened yesterday. The process has been ongoing for the last three or four months now," said one analyst.
HSBC Holdings shares were also helped by a strong performance in Hong Kong overnight. The Hang Seng Index closed up 137.38 points at 12,943.69.
